South Dakota: what's on the November 3, 2026 ballot

Every candidate below is listed alphabetically, with party shown as text only. Open a name for their stated positions, background and recent news, each with sources.

Open South Dakota on the map

Key dates

  • In-person early (absentee) voting: September 18, 2026 to November 2, 2026. Vote in person at your county auditor's office or a satellite site. Early voting ends at 5 p.m. on the day before Election Day.
  • Voter registration deadline: October 19, 2026. Your registration must reach your county auditor 15 days before Election Day. You can check your status at vip.sdsos.gov.
  • Last day to request a mail absentee ballot: November 2, 2026. Your request must reach your county auditor by 5 p.m. Because of mail time, ask well before this date. Your ballot must be returned by the time polls close on Election Day.
  • Election Day: November 3, 2026. Polls are open from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. local time.

Official election information: vote.gov

Who's running

Only the U.S. Senate and governor races are loaded so far. Other statewide offices, ballot measures, U.S. House and local races aren't loaded yet. Check your sample ballot for the full list.
